scientific_integrity: Symbolic general proof and two executed independent finite checkers; no independent scholarly audit or formal infinite machine proof.
scientific_limitations: Whole-family equivalence requires bipartiteness, no four-cycles, and diameter at most three; the Heawood census is finite and reproducibly exhaustive. Earlier minimum geodetic flag bases are known, unindexed historical priority is not certified. June 3 2013 is the publisher-verified online posting date for a foundational article that appeared in a 2007 print volume; it is not a claim of earliest physical printing.
title: Geodetic and edge-geodetic sets coincide on bipartite girth-six diameter-three graphs
